auto_renew_help:
When this service is running out of data or time, the bot pays from your wallet and renews it or buys extra data/days on its own.
Pick a plan to renew with, or how much extra data and how many extra days to add.
auto_renew_state_stopped: ⚠️ Auto-renew has stopped. Pick an option to turn it on again.
auto_renew_state_short: 💳 Your wallet balance is too low; top it up and the renewal goes through on its own.
auto_renew_nothing: This service has nothing auto-renew could buy.
auto_renew_stopped: ⚠️ Auto-renew for {name} has stopped because the chosen option is no longer available. Please set it up again.
